extracted.name: Garden Pasta Salad
extracted.description: This chilled garden pasta salad is loaded with crunchy vegetables, flavored with nutty Parmesan cheese, and tossed in your favorite Italian-style salad dressing.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 cup cucumber, peeled and thinly sliced
1.5 (16 ounce) bottles Italian-style salad dressing, or to taste
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil; cook pasta at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Rinse under cold water, and drain.

Mix tomatoes, celery, carrots, bell pepper, cucumber, and onion together in a large bowl. Add cooled pasta, salad dressing, and Parmesan; mix until well combined. Cover and chill for 1 hour before serving.
